--!strict
--============================================================
-- DeliveryClient (LocalScript) — v2
-- Ubicación: StarterPlayerScripts
-- Etiqueta de información de la entrega (destino, modificador,
-- recompensa) y detección de llegada. El reloj vive en TimerHUD.
-- Solo MUESTRA información y envía solicitudes; el servidor valida.
--============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DeliveryRemotes")
local RequestDelivery = remotes:WaitForChild("RequestDelivery") :: RemoteEvent
local DeliveryComplete = remotes:WaitForChild("DeliveryComplete") :: RemoteEvent
local DeliveryAssigned = remotes:WaitForChild("DeliveryAssigned") :: RemoteEvent
local DeliveryEnded = remotes:WaitForChild("DeliveryEnded") :: RemoteEvent

-- Presentación (no son valores de mecánica)
local KEY_REQUEST = Enum.KeyCode.E -- atajo de prueba para pedir entrega
local RESULT_DISPLAY_SECONDS = 3
local ARRIVAL_CHECK_RATE = 0.25

-- UI mínima: etiqueta de información de la entrega
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "DeliveryUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Name = "DeliveryStatus"
label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20)
label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 460, 0, 56)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
label.TextScaled = true
label.Visible = false
label.Parent = screenGui

-- Estado local de presentación
local activeDestination: BasePart? = nil
local activeArrivalRadius = 0
local deliveryActive = false
local completionRequested = false

DeliveryAssigned.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("DeliveryPoints")
	local point = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(payload.destinationName)
	activeDestination = if point and point:IsA("BasePart") then point else nil
	activeArrivalRadius = payload.arrivalRadius
	deliveryActive = true
	completionRequested = false
	label.Text = string.format(
		"📦 %s | Destino: %s | Recompensa: %d",
		payload.modifierName,
		payload.destinationName,
		payload.reward
	)
	label.Visible = true

	-- Aviso de llegada (el servidor valida de verdad)
	task.spawn(function()
		while deliveryActive do
			if activeDestination and not completionRequested then
				local character = player.Character
				local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
					local distance = (root.Position - activeDestination.Position).Magnitude
					if distance <= activeArrivalRadius then
						completionRequested = true
						DeliveryComplete:FireServer()
					end
				end
			end
			task.wait(ARRIVAL_CHECK_RATE)
		end
	end)
end)

DeliveryEnded.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	deliveryActive = false
	activeDestination = nil
	if payload.result == "Completed" then
		label.Text = string.format("✅ ¡Entrega completada! +%d monedas", payload.reward)
	else
		label.Text = "❌ Entrega fallida: " .. tostring(payload.reason)
	end
	task.delay(RESULT_DISPLAY_SECONDS, function()
		if not deliveryActive then
			label.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end)

-- Atajo de prueba: pulsar E para solicitar una entrega
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then
		return
	end
	if input.KeyCode == KEY_REQUEST then
		RequestDelivery:FireServer()
	end
end)
children.name: DeliveryClient

--!strict
--============================================================
-- TimerHUD (LocalScript)
-- Ubicación: StarterPlayerScripts
-- Mecánica 02: el tiempo aparece en el HUD.
-- Reloj de cuenta regresiva sincronizado con el servidor mediante
-- workspace:GetServerTimeNow(). Solo MUESTRA el tiempo; el
-- servidor es la autoridad.
--============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("TimerRemotes")
local TimerStart = remotes:WaitForChild("TimerStart") :: RemoteEvent
local TimerSync = remotes:WaitForChild("TimerSync") :: RemoteEvent
local TimerEnd = remotes:WaitForChild("TimerEnd") :: RemoteEvent

-- Presentación (valores visuales, no de mecánica)
local COLOR_NORMAL = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local COLOR_WARNING = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
local HUD_REFRESH = 0.1
local RESULT_HIDE_DELAY = 2
local SYNC_TOLERANCE = 0.5 -- tolerancia de deriva antes de corregir

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "TimerHUD"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local clockLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
clockLabel.Name = "Clock"
clockLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
clockLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 84) -- debajo de la etiqueta de entrega
clockLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 64)
clockLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
clockLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
clockLabel.TextColor3 = COLOR_NORMAL
clockLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
clockLabel.TextScaled = true
clockLabel.Visible = false
clockLabel.Parent = screenGui

-- Estado local de presentación
local endsAt = 0
local warningThreshold = 0
local hudActive = false

local function formatClock(seconds: number): string
	local total = math.max(0, math.ceil(seconds))
	local mins = math.floor(total / 60)
	local secs = total % 60
	return string.format("%02d:%02d", mins, secs)
end

TimerStart.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	endsAt = payload.endsAt
	warningThreshold = payload.warningThreshold
	hudActive = true
	clockLabel.Visible = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while hudActive do
			local remaining = endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			if remaining <= 0 then
				clockLabel.Text = "00:00"
				break -- el servidor anunciará el resultado
			end
			clockLabel.Text = formatClock(remaining)
			clockLabel.TextColor3 = if remaining <= warningThreshold then COLOR_WARNING else COLOR_NORMAL
			task.wait(HUD_REFRESH)
		end
	end)
end)

TimerSync.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	-- Corrección de deriva: el servidor es la autoridad del tiempo
	local expectedEndsAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + payload.remaining
	if math.abs(expectedEndsAt - endsAt) > SYNC_TOLERANCE then
		endsAt = expectedEndsAt
	end
end)

TimerEnd.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	hudActive = false
	if payload.result == "Expired" then
		clockLabel.Text = "00:00"
		clockLabel.TextColor3 = COLOR_WARNING
	end
	task.delay(RESULT_HIDE_DELAY, function()
		if not hudActive then
			clockLabel.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end)
children.name: TimerHUD
